subject: [PATCH v5 06/15] SUNRPC: report local rpcbind calls that get no answer

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch modifies the SUNRPC code to report local rpcbind calls that fail without an answer, distinguishing between different types of failures such as transport errors and soft timeouts. It introduces a new counter in the svc_serv structure to track the number of unanswered rpcbind calls, which will be used by later patches to adjust their behavior accordingly.
